title: Mandate 85: no agent holds a claim after it is done with it
goal: Vision: V-10. CEO directive 2026-11-16: an agent cannot hold a claim after it is done with it. Record CEO Mandate 85 in core (constitution entry, docs/ceo-mandate-85.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, README, self-build contract with no net line added to core under Mandate 84) and guard it in the governance tests. The workflow tool that releases leftover claims is in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (its T-AGENTCLAUDECLAIMDONE-1).

reuse.searched: Mandate 83 rule 2 and its record, the self-build contract (crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs), the governance guards (tests/architecture_tests.rs, tests/agent_bootstrap.rs), and the workflow tool's claim life cycle in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (workflow finish, workflow ship's settle_published, tasks release, claim_once's claim_settled_on_main). Core carries the rule and its documents; the release of leftover claims is the commercial tool's (AG1VISION's T-AG1MANDATE85-1 there, with a tested change offered on the board). No code path, dependency or harvest in core.

limitations: Core carries the rule, its documents, the self-build clause and the governance tests. Releasing leftover claims is done by the workflow tool in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps.
The tool cannot see that an agent stopped or turned to other work; the one-hour lease catches that.
The self-build clause was added with no net line in core (Mandate 84).
